questions.question: Please review the statement that swept area equals segment length times the length of the midpoint’s path. In general the relevant component of motion is perpendicular to the segment, and a simple arc-length product needs additional conditions. The source statement is retained.

The Smithsonian’s planimeter collection uses Johann Martin Hermann and gives construction dates 1818, 1825 and 1826 for Hermann, Gonnella and Oppikofer, whereas the source supplies Herman, an 1814 idea, and 1824/1827 inventions. Please distinguish proposals from construction and authorise any spelling/date corrections. Source wording is retained. Evidence: https://americanhistory.si.edu/collections/object-groups/planimeters
